{{Top|leg}}
'''Chuba poison''' was a type of [[Poison/Legends|poison]] that caused a stroke. It was made from the glands of the [[Gorg/Legends|Gorg]].
The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Sissalik]] used this poison to [[Death/Legends|kill]] his enslaver, [[Farvakine]].<ref name="Ando">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030703ando|text=Ando: Planet of the Walrus Men|int=Ando: Planet of the Walrus Men}}</ref>
